title: Rate Card: Monthly Fee and Enrolment Charge on the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan
content:
USD 14.95 a month is the lowest fee at which a vehicle is carried on the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan, and USD 89.95 the highest. The monthly fee follows the plan the vehicle is written on; the enrolment charge is a one-off amount taken when the plan starts, and it falls only to the plan that carries one. All amounts are in USD.

| Plan | Monthly fee | Enrolment charge | Billing day may be moved |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Care Essentials Plan | 14.95 | 0.00 | No |
| Keyturn Care Routine Plan | 24.95 | 0.00 | Yes |
| Keyturn Care Complete Plan | 39.95 | 0.00 | Yes |
| Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan | 59.95 | 49.00 | Yes |
| Keyturn Care Fleet Plan | 89.95 | 0.00 | Yes |
| Keyturn Care Electric Plan | 44.95 | 0.00 | Yes |

### Reading the card

Taking the six plans together as the card sets them out, the Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan is the only one of them on which an enrolment charge falls due, at 49.00, and the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan is the only one of them whose billing day is fixed for the life of the plan.

The same figures read host by host: a vehicle written on the Keyturn Care Routine Plan is billed 24.95 for each month of the plan and nothing on enrolment, while a vehicle written on the Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan is billed 59.95 for each month and 49.00 once at the start. Between the cheapest and the dearest plan on the card the monthly difference is 75.00.
